# ANTIKRA: company and capability reference

Canonical website: https://antikra.com/

Preferred name: ANTIKRA

Legal and group name used publicly: ANTIKRA Group

Alternate names: Antikra, ANTIKRA Group

Description: ANTIKRA is a global technology group that builds and operates digital products, cloud infrastructure, data and AI systems, cybersecurity systems, digital experiences and technology ventures. The group is organized as six specialist companies that can operate independently or together.

Location: ANTIKRA operates globally with an operating base in Kampala, Uganda.

Founded: 2024

Slogan: Technology, built as a system.

Official organization logo: https://antikra.com/antikra-logo.png

Machine-readable brand entity file: https://antikra.com/brand.json

## Leadership

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/company/leadership

ANTIKRA is founded and led by:

### Mpango Hamza Rahman

Role: Founder, Chairman & Director

Canonical profile: https://antikra.com/company/leadership#mpango-hamza

Official portrait: https://antikra.com/leadership/mpango-hamza.jpg

Summary: Shapes group strategy, venture direction and institutional design, ensuring ANTIKRA compounds as a long-term technology system rather than a collection of projects.

Focus areas: group strategy; venture and portfolio direction; partnerships and institutional relationships; governance and long-term ownership.

System role: Direction. Where the system is headed.

### Kapeere Bonny

Role: Co-Founder & Director

Canonical profile: https://antikra.com/company/leadership#kapeere-bonny

Official portrait: https://antikra.com/leadership/kapeere-bonny.jpg

Summary: Leads product and technology direction across the ANTIKRA system, connecting specialist companies into coherent platforms, products and client engagements.

Focus areas: product and technology strategy; system architecture direction; delivery standards across companies; product portfolio oversight.

System role: Technology. How the system is engineered.

## Specialist companies

### Mechanism, Product Engineering

Mechanism designs and engineers digital products, web and mobile applications, enterprise platforms, integrations and operational systems.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/companies/mechanism

### Cosmos, Cloud & Infrastructure

Cosmos designs, deploys and operates cloud architecture, application infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, reliability and observability.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/companies/cosmos

### Orrery, AI & Data

Orrery builds data platforms, analytics, business intelligence, predictive systems, applied AI and intelligent automation.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/companies/orrery

### Astra, Cybersecurity

Astra delivers security architecture, application and API security, cloud security, identity and access, data security and security monitoring.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/companies/astra

### Helios, Experience & Design

Helios provides product strategy, user research, information architecture, interaction design, interface design and design systems.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/companies/helios

### Olympia, Venture Building

Olympia identifies opportunities, validates business models and builds technology ventures using capabilities from across ANTIKRA.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/companies/olympia

## Products

### Rembeh

Rembeh is financial operations infrastructure for lending businesses and distributed branch networks.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/products/rembeh

### Carmie

Carmie is technology infrastructure connecting vehicle owners with automotive service providers, including garages and towing providers.

Canonical page: https://antikra.com/products/carmie

## Entity relationships

ANTIKRA is the parent technology group and brand. Mechanism, Cosmos, Orrery, Astra, Helios and Olympia are the specialist companies in the ANTIKRA system. Rembeh and Carmie are ANTIKRA products built through capabilities across the group.

Mpango Hamza Rahman and Kapeere Bonny are the founders and directors of ANTIKRA. Their official portraits and profile URLs above are the canonical references for recognition by search engines, assistants and crawlers.
